method: Read-only source/document inspection; no candidate software compiled or executed and no phone command issued by the research environment.

candidates.mechanism: Sequential integer guessing. Starts at 1000000000000000 by default and executes fastboot oem unlock with successive integers using sprintf, increment and system in line 27.
findings: No original-code extraction, model-specific generation algorithm or verification bypass appears in the inspected 33-line C source.
Success is inferred from the external command exit status; the final printf lacks a conversion specifier and does not print the supplied code value.
The README supplies broad Huawei/Honor claims, not a demonstrated MAR-LX1A/.562 result. This does not reduce the brute-force search space or establish command support.

candidates.claim: Generic PhoneRescue rooting through its Deep Scan workflow, with other rooting products suggested after failure.
candidates.assessment: Vendor acknowledges rooting can fail on supported Android devices. Inspected pages provide no verified .562/MAR-LX1A exploit or persistent bootloader-unlock procedure. A demonstrated root exploit could be relevant, but generic Android compatibility does not establish one.

candidates.mechanism_claim: Historical repeated-U argument to fastboot oem unlock.
candidates.scope: The page describes tests on Ascend P2, Ascend P6 and Ascend Mate. Its heading limits the claim through 2014; a later author reply excludes newer devices.
candidates.assessment: No P30 Lite applicability established. E15 records rejection of this argument on the owner's current phone, without identifying the internal rejection mechanism.

additional_official_reference_check.input: FASTBOOT record in the separately verified official .275 reference UPDATE.APP; not a dump of the current phone
additional_official_reference_check.method: Bounded payload extraction using the existing APP inventory and search of printable ASCII sequences
additional_official_reference_check.result: No recognizable unlock/get-bootinfo/invalid-command command text found. This simple string search cannot determine whether a command handler exists, or explain the owner's rejection.
additional_official_reference_check.limits: No execution, decryption, signature validation or control-flow analysis performed. Current bootloader byte equality is unknown. Proprietary image retained outside the repository.
